text:
Nora: FYI we saw a midday surge that blew pacing after the creative roll. Propose a short microburst test: 3 creatives x 2 retarget cohorts + an inbound routing sanity check. Can we stand this up today?

Felix: I can spin it up. Suggest limit to 5 high-intent queries and set a 10% holdback. keep canary to 8 hours.

Jaya: agree. I'll prepare two landing variants (concise value vs. case-stat). Also will add 3 headline permutations.

AdOps Bot: hourly-summary.csv available -> https://storage.redwood.com/ads/239876/hourly.csv (AM pacing +42%, CTR -0.5).

Otis: ops asks: smoothing factor 0.3, disable bid spikes >12% during test, retarget frequency cap 3/day. Inbound webhook must ACK 200 < 500ms or fallback.

Felix: keywords = `redwood inference`, `hosted inference`, `inference cost`. negatives: free, torrent, crack.

Jaya: assets uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/marketing/microburst_march (files: micro_A.jpg, micro_B.jpg, lp_short.html, lp_case.html).

Felix: curl test for CRM webhook:
```
curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood.com/inbound -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"gclid":"test-239876","utm_campaign":"microburst_march","creative":"microA"}'
```

Otis: analytics plan: cohorts micro_A, micro_B, micro_C and rt_30d, rt_7d. Dashboard tiles for CTR, CPC, CPL, SQL rate. Alert if CPL > 20% vs baseline for 2 windows.

Nora: budget: search $9k/day, retarget $2.5k/day. Canary spend = 15% with 8h window. Scale if CTR +6% and CPL -10%.

Felix: implementing canary now. will pin rollout notes in Ads manager and enable hourly pacing checks.

Jaya: testing pixel and utm mapping on staging. will confirm when live.

AdOps Bot: canary-log created -> https://storage.redwood.com/ads/canary/239876/log.txt

Otis: reminder: route leads to retry queue if webhook latency >500ms, tag for manual review. conversion lookback 30d.

Felix: canary live. ping after gclid test passes. :rocket:

Jaya: gclid test returned 200, hits visible in test stream. LP variants live.

Nora: monitoring first 3h. keep updates short here.

Otis: early signal: CTR up +2%, CPC +4%, watching CPL. will report at 6h.
